// Explicit private P09 companion. Requires unchanged navbar.go/navbar.templ.
package converted

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// NewNavbarWithRoutes retains the source-styled navigation and adds persistent,
// browser-native access to the same GET destinations. It does not certify a UI.
func NewNavbarWithRoutes(data Navbar, summary string) (templ.Component, error) {
	if err := validateNavbar(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !navbarText(summary, 256) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("navbar routes: invalid summary")
	}
	snapshot := data
	snapshot.Links = append([]NavbarLink(nil), data.Links...)
	if data.Notifications != nil {
		notification := *data.Notifications
		snapshot.Notifications = &notification
	}
	if data.Account != nil {
		account := *data.Account
		account.Links = append([]NavbarDestination(nil), data.Account.Links...)
		snapshot.Account = &account
	}
	primary, err := NewNavbar(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return guardedNavbar(navbarWithRoutes(primary, snapshot, summary)), nil
}
